question: Who was the player of the match in the semi-final of the T20 Women’s World Cup 2023 played between India and Australia?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ashleigh Gardner**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Ashleigh Gardner is an Australian cricketer who plays as an all-rounder.
 
• She was awarded the Player of the Match in the semi-final of the T20 Women's World Cup 2023.
 
• In the semi-final match against India, Gardner made significant contributions with both bat and ball.
 
• Her performance was crucial in leading Australia to the final of the T20 Women's World Cup 2023.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **T20 Women's World Cup**

 
 
• The T20 Women's World Cup is an international championship of Twenty20 cricket organized by the International Cricket Council (ICC).
 
• The tournament format consists of a round-robin group stage followed by knockout matches, including semi-finals and a final.
 
• It is one of the most prestigious events in women's cricket, featuring teams from around the world.
 
• The 2023 edition showcased excellent performances and competitive spirit among the participating teams.
 
 
 
• **Semi-Final Match**
 
 
• The semi-final match is a critical knockout stage in the tournament where the winning team proceeds to the final.
 
• In the 2023 edition, the semi-final between India and Australia was highly anticipated due to the strong track records of both teams.
 
• Key players' performances in semi-finals often play a pivotal role in determining the outcome of the match.
 
 
 
• **Player of the Match**
 
 
• The Player of the Match award is given to the standout performer in a particular match.
 
• This award recognizes the player who has made the most significant impact on the match's outcome through exceptional performance.
 
• In the context of the T20 Women's World Cup, this award is highly prestigious and highlights individual brilliance on a global stage.
